title: Your Car May Be Spying on You

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来一直致力于帮助您了解世界，并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: As modern cars become ever more sophisticated pieces of technology, they've begun sharing information about their drivers, sometimes with unnerving consequences.
sentences.zh: 随着现代汽车变得越来越精密，它们开始分享驾驶员的信息，有时会带来令人不安的后果。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Kashmir Hill explains what our cars now know and what this means for our lives.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事克什米尔·希尔将解释我们的汽车现在都知道些什么，以及这对我们的生活意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月18日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Kashmir, you're a data and technology reporter and you usually come on the show to tell us some very frightening new way that technology is going to affect our lives.
sentences.zh: 那么克什米尔，你是一位数据和技术记者，你通常来节目是为了告诉我们一些技术将如何以非常可怕的新方式影响我们的生活。

sentences.en: This time, though, you're coming on the show to talk about cars.
sentences.zh: 不过这次，你来节目是为了谈论汽车。

sentences.en: Why cars?
sentences.zh: 为什么是汽车？

sentences.en: Well, like many Americans, during the pandemic, I got a new car.
sentences.zh: 嗯，像许多美国人一样，疫情期间我买了一辆新车。

sentences.en: And I hadn't had a car since 1999 when I was in high school.
sentences.zh: 自1999年我上高中以来，我就没再开过车。

sentences.en: And cars have changed a lot.
sentences.zh: 汽车已经发生了很大的变化。

sentences.en: They've gotten much better.
sentences.zh: 它们变得好多了。

sentences.en: They're more sophisticated.
sentences.zh: 它们更精密了。

sentences.en: I mean, they're basically computers on wheels.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们基本上就是装了轮子的电脑。

sentences.en: But I know that when you connect things to the Internet, it has the ability to record data about you, watch you,
sentences.zh: 但我知道，当你把东西连接到互联网上时，它就有能力记录关于你的数据，监视你，

sentences.en: potentially spy on you if you don't know what kind of data is being collected and sent out.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道正在收集和发送什么样的数据，它可能会监视你。

sentences.en: So you're sitting in this new car looking around thinking,
sentences.zh: 所以你坐在新车里环顾四周，心想，

sentences.en: OK, this stuff is probably spying on me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这些东西可能在监视我。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I wondered what kind of data are cars collecting now?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，汽车现在在收集什么样的数据？

sentences.en: And where are they sending it?
sentences.zh: 它们把数据发到哪里去了？

sentences.en: Who's getting it?
sentences.zh: 谁收到了这些数据？

sentences.en: I just wanted to know, who's tapping into these cars?
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，谁在窃取这些汽车的信息？

sentences.en: OK, over here.
sentences.zh: 好的，这边请。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this reporting led me to a woman named Christine.
sentences.zh: 这篇报道把我引向了一位名叫克里斯汀的女士。

sentences.en: My name is Christine Deldo Ogden, and I'm from Bossier City, Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 我叫克里斯汀·德尔多·奥格登，来自路易斯安那州的博西尔城。
zh_words: 克里斯汀·德尔多·奥格登

sentences.en: Christine is a real estate agent in Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀是路易斯安那州的一名房地产经纪人。

sentences.en: And for a while, she also sold medical supplies.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，她也卖医疗用品。

sentences.en: So her car, a Mercedes, was really important to her work.
sentences.zh: 所以她的车，一辆梅赛德斯，对她的工作非常重要。

sentences.en: I had a Class C 300, and actually my car was basically like my roving office.
sentences.zh: 我有一辆C300，实际上我的车基本上就像我的流动办公室。

sentences.en: And as a rep in that capacity, you have to live in your car.
sentences.zh: 作为一名代表，你必须住在车里。

sentences.en: So it's pretty much like you're home away from home.
sentences.zh: 所以它几乎就像你的第二个家。

sentences.en: Christina had been married for 10 years, and her now late husband was a federal agent and abusive.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀结婚10年了，她现在已故的丈夫是一名联邦探员，而且有虐待倾向。

sentences.en: I kind of started losing my independence, I guess you could say.
sentences.zh: 我想你可以说，我开始失去独立性了。

sentences.en: And one night, he got violent with her, and she decided to leave him.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，他对她施暴，她决定离开他。

sentences.en: She got in her car, and she drove five hours away to where her daughter lived.
sentences.zh: 她上了车，开了五个小时的车，去了她女儿住的地方。

sentences.en: She ended up filing a police report against her husband for domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 她最终因家庭暴力向警方举报了她的丈夫。

sentences.en: And she did not want to be in contact, but he's texting her.
sentences.zh: 她不想再有任何联系，但他一直在给她发短信。

sentences.en: He's calling her.
sentences.zh: 他在给她打电话。

sentences.en: And then he started sending her messages that indicate he knows where she is.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始给她发信息，表明他知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: In real time.
sentences.zh: 实时的。

sentences.en: And there were a lot of weird incidents, like this one particular incident, where she was on a work trip.
sentences.zh: 发生了很多奇怪的事情，比如有一次，她去出差。

sentences.en: And I'm sitting in a parking lot.
sentences.zh: 我当时正坐在停车场里。

sentences.en: And she was waiting for her colleague in her car.
sentences.zh: 她在车里等她的同事。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, he shows up and backs up, rolls his windows down, and is looking at me.
sentences.zh: 突然，他出现了，倒车，摇下车窗，盯着我看。

sentences.en: He suddenly shows up in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 他突然出现在停车场。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And she had already made sure that he couldn't track her phone.
sentences.zh: 她之前已经确保他无法追踪她的手机了。

sentences.en: And then she realizes...
sentences.zh: 然后她意识到……

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And it just hit me in that moment that it has to be the car.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我突然意识到，一定是车的问题。

sentences.en: It has to be the car.
sentences.zh: 一定是车的问题。

sentences.en: That the only way it could be happening is that he is tracking her car.
sentences.zh: 唯一可能发生这种情况的原因就是他在追踪她的车。

sentences.en: And then I started thinking about, well, the only thing that is tied me to this car is going to be that Mercedes app.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始想，好吧，唯一把我跟这辆车联系在一起的就是那个梅赛德斯应用程序。

sentences.en: So, her Mercedes was connected to an app Mercedes offers called Mercedes Me.
sentences.zh: 所以，她的梅赛德斯连接了一个梅赛德斯提供的名为“Mercedes Me”的应用程序。

sentences.en: So, I get on there, and there's all this information on there that says, you know, you can open your car door.
sentences.zh: 我登录上去，上面有各种信息，你知道，你可以打开车门。

sentences.en: And it's one of these connected car apps.
sentences.zh: 这是联网汽车应用程序之一。

sentences.en: You can use it to lock and unlock the vehicle, maybe turn it on remotely.
sentences.zh: 你可以用它来锁车和解锁，甚至远程启动。

sentences.en: And you can also find out the location of the car.
sentences.zh: 你还可以查到汽车的位置。

sentences.en: And so, that's what her husband was doing.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是她丈夫在做的事情。

sentences.en: He was tracking the location of the car and thus seeing everywhere she went.
sentences.zh: 他在追踪汽车的位置，从而看到了她去过的每一个地方。

sentences.en: I had no idea he was actually watching every move I made.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道他实际上在监视我的一举一动。

sentences.en: That car was a red light, you know, shining that, oh, she's here, oh, she's there.
sentences.zh: 那辆车就像一盏红灯，你知道，闪烁着，哦，她在这儿，哦，她在那里。

sentences.en: And he's constantly checking, you know, that app, looking to see where I was.
sentences.zh: 他一直在查看那个应用程序，看看我在哪里。

sentences.en: We verified that.
sentences.zh: 我们核实了这一点。

sentences.en: So, what does she do once she has this information?
sentences.zh: 那么，她得到这个信息后做了什么？

sentences.en: So, at this point, she already has a restraining order against him.
sentences.zh: 此时，她已经对他申请了限制令。

sentences.en: So, she lets the detective on her case know, hey, he's tracking me.
sentences.zh: 所以，她告诉负责她案件的侦探，嘿，他在追踪我。

sentences.en: And that's when we start calling Mercedes.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始给梅赛德斯打电话。

sentences.en: And I explain to them.
sentences.zh: 我向他们解释了情况。

sentences.en: She calls Mercedes because she wants to get his access to the car, you know, turned off, revoked.
sentences.zh: 她给梅赛德斯打电话，因为她想让他对汽车的访问权限被关闭、撤销。

sentences.en: I didn't know he was going to use the ambulance.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他会利用这个。

sentences.en: He's going to track everywhere I went.
sentences.zh: 他会追踪我去的每一个地方。

sentences.en: And that's what he's been doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是他一直在做的事情。

sentences.en: He's tracking me everywhere I go.
sentences.zh: 他追踪我去的每一个地方。

sentences.en: But hang on, let me ask you a question.
sentences.zh: 但是等等，让我问你一个问题。

sentences.en: Let me ask you, if you don't.
sentences.zh: 让我问你，如果你不……

sentences.en: She is running into problems because he's the owner of the car.
sentences.zh: 她遇到了麻烦，因为他是车主。

sentences.en: Did they say that the vehicle could be in your name?
sentences.zh: 他们说这辆车可以登记在你的名下吗？

sentences.en: Or was it an agreement that the vehicle says it's in his name?
sentences.zh: 还是说协议规定车登记在他的名下？

sentences.en: The title is in his name.
sentences.zh: 产权证上是他的名字。

sentences.en: And Christine told me it's a decision that they made because he had better credit.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀告诉我，这是他们做出的决定，因为他的信用更好。

sentences.en: But she is the one paying for the car.
sentences.zh: 但付车款的人是她。

sentences.en: I've got it in my papers that I have access to the car.
sentences.zh: 我的文件里有我有权使用这辆车的证明。

sentences.en: I'm the only one that's ever really paid a note on this car.
sentences.zh: 我是唯一真正为这辆车付过款的人。

sentences.en: And she actually had an order from the judge that had awarded her ownership of the car during divorce proceedings.
sentences.zh: 而且她确实有法官的命令，在离婚诉讼期间将车的所有权判给了她。

sentences.en: She had this temporary restraining order.
sentences.zh: 她有这个临时限制令。

sentences.en: And so she's telling Mercedes, look, I know he's technically the owner of the car, but this is my car.
sentences.zh: 所以她告诉梅赛德斯，听着，我知道从技术上讲他是车主，但这辆车是我的。

sentences.en: A judge has said this is my car.
sentences.zh: 法官已经判这辆车是我的了。

sentences.en: I have a restraining order against him.
sentences.zh: 我对他有限制令。

sentences.en: He's not supposed to be getting this access to me.
sentences.zh: 他不应该再能通过这种方式接触我了。

sentences.en: Please turn this off.
sentences.zh: 请把它关掉。

sentences.en: But he has violated several protection orders because he stalks me on this car.
sentences.zh: 但他已经违反了好几次保护令，因为他通过这辆车跟踪我。

sentences.en: And it's really hard to do anything.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难处理。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And she calls repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 她反复打电话。

sentences.en: Because I know I can't be the only woman if this has happened to.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道我绝不可能是唯一一个遭遇这种事的女性。

sentences.en: And they can't help her.
sentences.zh: 但他们帮不了她。

sentences.en: Crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: The person who owned the car had the right to be connected to the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 拥有汽车的人有权连接到车辆。

sentences.en: And Mercedes just didn't seem to have any kind of protocol for what to do when this happens.
sentences.zh: 梅赛德斯似乎根本没有任何应对这种情况的协议。

sentences.en: That is really, really remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常非常引人注目。

sentences.en: So what does she do?
sentences.zh: 那么她做了什么？

sentences.en: So she eventually ends up taking the Mercedes to a mechanic.
sentences.zh: 她最终把梅赛德斯开到了修理厂。

sentences.en: And she pays $400 for him to basically pull the device in the car that provides internet connectivity.
sentences.zh: 她付了400美元，让修理工把车里提供互联网连接的设备拆掉。

sentences.en: So she disconnects her car.
sentences.zh: 所以她断开了她的车。

sentences.en: And it meant that she lost kind of navigation services in the car.
sentences.zh: 这意味着她失去了车里的导航服务。

sentences.en: She lost the ability to call roadside assistance.
sentences.zh: 她失去了呼叫道路救援的能力。

sentences.en: But she didn't care.
sentences.zh: 但她不在乎。

sentences.en: She said, I just don't want him to be able to track me.
sentences.zh: 她说，我只是不想让他能追踪到我。

sentences.en: It's pretty terrifying, this story, Cash.
sentences.zh: 这个故事太可怕了，卡什。

sentences.en: And I have to say, it's pretty surprising to me that there wasn't a way Mercedes could stop this.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，梅赛德斯竟然没有办法阻止这种情况，这让我感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: What did Mercedes say about this?
sentences.zh: 梅赛德斯对此怎么说？

sentences.en: Mercedes said they could not comment on an individual customer.
sentences.zh: 梅赛德斯表示，他们不对个别客户发表评论。

sentences.en: But this is not just Mercedes.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是梅赛德斯的问题。

sentences.en: There have been other reports of women.
sentences.zh: 还有其他关于女性的报道。

sentences.en: This happened to other car brands with Tesla.
sentences.zh: 这种情况也发生在特斯拉等其他汽车品牌上。

sentences.en: The detective in Christine's case, it actually had another case just like this with a Lexus.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀案中的侦探，实际上处理过另一个和雷克萨斯有关的类似案件。

sentences.en: And I think what's really troubling here is that cars are a lifeline for these women.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里真正令人不安的是，汽车是这些女性的生命线。

sentences.en: It's literally how they are getting away from abusive situations.
sentences.zh: 这确实是她们逃离虐待环境的方式。

sentences.en: But because it's connected to the internet, it's another place where they can be tracked and harassed.
sentences.zh: 但因为它连接到互联网，它成了另一个可以追踪和骚扰她们的地方。

sentences.en: And this is the paradox of connected cars.
sentences.zh: 这就是联网汽车的悖论。

sentences.en: They are no longer private spaces.
sentences.zh: 它们不再是私人空间了。

sentences.en: And what do we make about the fact that these cars, you know, they have all this technology that now, as we're seeing, can be exploited.
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待这些汽车拥有所有这些技术，而正如我们所见，这些技术现在可以被利用的事实？

sentences.en: But the car manufacturers don't seem to have anticipated that.
sentences.zh: 但汽车制造商似乎并没有预料到这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, car manufacturers have been making cars for a long time.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，汽车制造商制造汽车已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: But they just started making these connected cars really just in the last decade.
sentences.zh: 但他们真正开始制造这些联网汽车也就是在过去十年里。

sentences.en: And car companies, when they have thought about safety, for example, in the past, they're thinking about seatbelts.
sentences.zh: 例如，汽车公司过去在考虑安全问题时，想的是安全带。

sentences.en: They're not thinking about data security.
sentences.zh: 他们没有考虑数据安全。

sentences.en: Privacy and harassment.
sentences.zh: 隐私和骚扰。

sentences.en: All of these things that happen when you have humans combined with technology.
sentences.zh: 当人类与技术结合时，所有这些事情都会发生。

sentences.en: These car companies are so new to this.
sentences.zh: 这些汽车公司对这些太陌生了。

sentences.en: And I don't think they've kind of worked out the kinks in the way that the Googles and the Facebooks of the world have to the extent that they have.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们像谷歌和Facebook那样解决了这些问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's just not, you know, their thing yet, right?
sentences.zh: 这还不是他们的强项，对吧？

sentences.en: They have come into this technology space, this digital space, looking around and not practiced at, like, how to treat data carefully and really what to do with it at all.
sentences.zh: 他们进入了这个技术领域，这个数字空间，环顾四周，却并不擅长如何谨慎地处理数据，以及到底该拿它怎么办。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so these are new problems for car makers, but they're not new problems when it comes to technology.
sentences.zh: 对于汽车制造商来说，这些确实是新问题，但如果从技术角度来看，它们并非什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: And this was a case of a bad actor invading the privacy of a driver.
sentences.zh: 这原本是一个不法分子侵犯驾驶员隐私的案例。

sentences.en: But as I continued my reporting, I discovered that car companies themselves were invading the privacy of millions of drivers.
sentences.zh: 但随着调查的深入，我发现汽车公司本身也在侵犯数百万驾驶员的隐私。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是 Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Mazursky，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才那几位一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games 开始体验吧。

sentences.en: So Kashmir, you said that these privacy issues in cars actually go beyond individuals exploiting technology.
sentences.zh: Kashmir，你刚才提到汽车领域的这些隐私问题实际上已经超出了个人利用技术的范畴。

sentences.en: That, in fact, you discovered that car companies themselves were invading people's privacy.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你发现汽车公司本身也在侵犯人们的隐私。

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 能跟我详细说说吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So for the story about how car apps were being used by abusers, I was spending a lot of time on car forums,
sentences.zh: 关于汽车应用程序被滥用者利用的报道，我当时花了很多时间在汽车论坛上，

sentences.en: places on the internet where people talk about their cars and their love of cars and their issues with cars, on Reddit, on kind of dedicated discussion boards.
sentences.zh: 也就是互联网上人们讨论汽车、表达对汽车的热爱以及交流用车问题的地方，比如 Reddit 或一些专门的讨论版。

sentences.en: And I kept seeing the same story over and over again.
sentences.zh: 我不断地看到同样的故事反复出现。

sentences.en: And it was people whose insurance rates had gone up, and they would ask the insurance agent, why did my insurance go up 20%, you know, 50%, or why can't I get insurance?
sentences.zh: 人们的保险费率上涨了，他们会问保险代理人：为什么我的保费涨了 20%，甚至 50%？或者为什么我买不到保险？

sentences.en: And the agent would tell them, you need to pull your LexisNexis report.
sentences.zh: 代理人会告诉他们：你需要去调取你的 LexisNexis 报告。

sentences.en: So LexisNexis, they're basically a big data broker.
sentences.zh: LexisNexis 基本上是一家大型数据经纪商。

sentences.en: And LexisNexis has a division called LexisNexis Risk Solutions.
sentences.zh: 它旗下有一个部门叫 LexisNexis Risk Solutions。

sentences.en: And historically, it's kept track of, you know, moving violations, speeding tickets, any accidents you've been in, whether you are at fault or not at fault.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，它一直记录着你的交通违规、超速罚单、发生的任何事故，以及你是否有过错。

sentences.en: And so these people go to LexisNexis, they ask for their files.
sentences.zh: 于是这些人去 LexisNexis 查询他们的档案。

sentences.en: And when it comes to them, the files are hundreds of pages long.
sentences.zh: 当他们拿到档案时，发现足足有几百页长。

sentences.en: And in them, they are finding information about every trip they have taken in their cars over the previous six months, how far they drove, when the trip started, when the trip
sentences.zh: 里面详细记录了他们过去六个月里每一次开车出行的信息，包括行驶距离、行程开始时间、行程

sentences.en: ended, how many times they hard-braked, hard-accelerated, or sped.
sentences.zh: 结束时间，以及急刹车、急加速或超速的次数。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And these people were shocked.
sentences.zh: 这些人感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: And so they came to the online forum saying, why is this happening?
sentences.zh: 于是他们来到在线论坛询问：为什么会发生这种情况？

sentences.en: Does anyone know why this is happening?
sentences.zh: 有人知道为什么会这样吗？

sentences.en: And how do I turn this off?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么关掉这个功能？

sentences.en: Okay, so what's the answer?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那答案是什么呢？

sentences.en: How was it happening?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: So, you know, we talked earlier that cars can collect this really detailed data.
sentences.zh: 如我们之前所谈到的，汽车可以收集非常详细的数据。

sentences.en: And that's what was happening.
sentences.zh: 这就是正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: The cars were collecting this data.
sentences.zh: 汽车正在收集这些数据。

sentences.en: This was happening to people who drove cars made by General Motors.
sentences.zh: 这种情况发生在驾驶通用汽车（General Motors）车辆的人身上。

sentences.en: General Motors was getting this data.
sentences.zh: 通用汽车正在获取这些数据。

sentences.en: And then General Motors was giving it to LexisNexis.
sentences.zh: 然后通用汽车又把数据交给了 LexisNexis。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Okay, so the car company itself was actually just handing it over?
sentences.zh: 所以，汽车公司本身竟然直接把数据交出去了？

sentences.en: Well, I don't think they were just doing it for free.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不认为他们是免费这么做的。

sentences.en: But yes, they were sharing and selling this data.
sentences.zh: 但确实，他们在共享并出售这些数据。

sentences.en: And it wasn't for everybody.
sentences.zh: 而且并非针对所有人。

sentences.en: It wasn't everybody who drove a GM car that this was happening to.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有开通用汽车的人都遇到了这种情况。

sentences.en: It was happening to a subset of people who had knowingly or unknowingly, in some cases, been enrolled in something called Smart Driver.
sentences.zh: 它只针对一小部分人，这些人可能是有意或无意地注册了一个叫“Smart Driver”的服务。

sentences.en: And what's Smart Driver?
sentences.zh: 什么是“Smart Driver”？

sentences.en: So Smart Driver is a feature offered by GM that's called OnStar Smart Driver.
sentences.zh: Smart Driver 是通用汽车提供的一项功能，全称是 OnStar Smart Driver。

sentences.en: And it's supposed to be a program to help you be a better driver.
sentences.zh: 它本应是一个帮助你成为更好驾驶员的项目。

sentences.en: And you can collect digital badges for being a good driver, like brake genius and speed limit hero.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过良好的驾驶习惯收集数字徽章，比如“刹车天才”和“限速英雄”。

sentences.en: And you get some feedback, like take it easy on the brakes, you know, don't speed up so much.
sentences.zh: 你还会得到一些反馈，比如“刹车时轻一点”、“别开太快”。

sentences.en: Make sure you're leaving room in front of your car so you're not going to hit the person in front of you.
sentences.zh: “确保与前车保持距离，以免撞到前方车辆。”

sentences.en: Like, don't tailgate.
sentences.zh: 比如，“不要跟车太近”。

sentences.en: So it's a little bit like one of those exercise apps, like great job.
sentences.zh: 所以它有点像那些健身应用程序，比如“干得好”。

sentences.en: You ran five miles.
sentences.zh: “你跑了五英里。”

sentences.en: Nice braking there.
sentences.zh: “刹车刹得不错。”

sentences.en: Or on the contrary.
sentences.zh: 或者反之亦然。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was that gamification of real life, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，这就是现实生活的游戏化，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, get a good score, be a good driver.
sentences.zh: 比如，拿个好分数，做一个好司机。

sentences.en: But what people who turned this on didn't realize was that there was something buried in the privacy policy that no one reads that said that they could share that data with
sentences.zh: 但开启这项功能的人并没有意识到，隐私政策里隐藏着一条没人会读的条款，写着他们可以将数据分享给

sentences.en: third parties.
sentences.zh: 第三方。

sentences.en: And the third parties that they were sharing it with were LexisNexis and another data broker that works with the insurance industry called Verisk.
sentences.zh: 而他们分享数据的第三方正是 LexisNexis 和另一家服务于保险业的数据经纪商 Verisk。

sentences.en: So some kind of vague, fine print lets them turn this driving game into a data harvesting machine, essentially.
sentences.zh: 所以，一些模糊的细则实际上让他们把这个驾驶游戏变成了一台数据收割机。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So when I talked to GM, the spokesperson said that people could turn this on in the vehicle app or at the dealership when they bought the car.
sentences.zh: 当我联系通用汽车时，发言人表示人们可以在车载应用程序或购买车辆时在经销商处开启此功能。

sentences.en: So it seemed possible that this was quietly being turned on at the dealership by salespeople.
sentences.zh: 所以，很有可能是销售人员在经销商处悄悄帮客户开启了这项功能。

sentences.en: And I found this company manual that said that salespeople could earn bonuses from GM by getting drivers to enroll in OnStar Connected Services, including SmartDriver.
sentences.zh: 我找到了一份公司手册，上面写着销售人员可以通过诱导驾驶员注册 OnStar 互联服务（包括 SmartDriver）来获得通用汽车的奖金。

sentences.en: I mean, there's something kind of creepy about it, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来有点毛骨悚然，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, these people were driving around.
sentences.zh: 这些人开着车到处走。

sentences.en: They had no idea that every move they made, including when they braked, when they turned, how fast they approached a stop sign, all of that was kind of being watched.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不知道自己的一举一动，包括何时刹车、何时转弯、以多快的速度接近停车标志，所有这些都在被监视。

sentences.en: It feels like a fundamental violation of privacy in your own car.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是对自己车内隐私的根本性侵犯。

sentences.en: One of the drivers I talked to said it felt like a betrayal, like he had no idea this information
sentences.zh: 我采访的一位司机说，这感觉像是一种背叛，他完全不知道这些信息

sentences.en: was getting collected and that it would be shared in this way that cost him financially, like his insurance went up.
sentences.zh: 正在被收集，并且会以这种方式被分享，从而导致他的经济损失，比如保费上涨。

sentences.en: And he said, I'm a safe driver.
sentences.zh: 他说：我是一个安全的驾驶员。

sentences.en: I've never been in an accident.
sentences.zh: 我从未出过事故。

sentences.en: I don't even kind of understand how they're judging me on this.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不明白他们是怎么根据这些来评判我的。

sentences.en: So it was really confusing to the people this was happening to.
sentences.zh: 所以对于那些遭遇此事的人来说，这真的非常令人困惑。

sentences.en: And how much were their rates actually going up?
sentences.zh: 他们的保费到底涨了多少？

sentences.en: Like, give me an example.
sentences.zh: 能给我举个例子吗？

sentences.en: So one Cadillac driver I talked to in Palm Beach, Florida, said that he actually got denied
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一位佛罗里达州棕榈滩的凯迪拉克车主说，他实际上被

sentences.en: by seven auto insurance companies and he wound up paying double what he was paying before for his auto insurance.
sentences.zh: 七家汽车保险公司拒保，最终他支付的汽车保险费是以前的两倍。

sentences.en: That is a huge increase.
sentences.zh: 那涨幅可真大。

sentences.en: How typical was that?
sentences.zh: 这种情况普遍吗？

sentences.en: Do you have a sense of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有了解吗？

sentences.en: You know, it's hard to tell.
sentences.zh: 很难说。

sentences.en: It was just a lot of posts on these different forums and some people said 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 在这些不同的论坛上有很多帖子，有些人说涨了 20%。

sentences.en: Some people didn't know how much it affected their insurance.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至不知道它对保险费的具体影响程度。

sentences.en: But yeah, it seemed to range from I saw 20 percent, I saw 50 percent and I saw people who said their insurance doubled.
sentences.zh: 但确实，涨幅似乎从我看到的 20%、50% 不等，甚至有人说他们的保费翻了一倍。

sentences.en: And what was the scope here in terms of companies?
sentences.zh: 那么从公司层面来看，范围有多广？

sentences.en: I mean, was this just GM?
sentences.zh: 你是说，这只是通用汽车的问题吗？

sentences.en: So I was only seeing people really explicitly complaining about GM cars.
sentences.zh: 我当时只看到人们明确地在抱怨通用汽车。

sentences.en: I'd had this experience of my insurance went up.
sentences.zh: 比如“我的保费涨了”。

sentences.en: I went to LexisNexis.
sentences.zh: “我去了 LexisNexis。”

sentences.en: I found my details.
sentences.zh: “我查到了我的详细记录。”

sentences.en: But then when I started looking into this, I saw that actually a lot of different automakers are starting to do a form of this.
sentences.zh: 但当我开始深入调查时，我发现实际上许多不同的汽车制造商都开始采用这种做法。

sentences.en: And some of the automakers said, you know, this is about safety.
sentences.zh: 一些汽车制造商表示，这是为了安全。

sentences.en: We're trying to help people be better drivers.
sentences.zh: 我们是在努力帮助人们成为更好的驾驶员。

sentences.en: Often they have like a driver score or driver feedback or a road score in their app.
sentences.zh: 他们通常会在应用程序中提供驾驶评分、驾驶反馈或道路评分。

sentences.en: And sometimes it's the data broker that's actually giving you the score in the app, not your automaker.
sentences.zh: 有时，在应用程序中为你评分的其实是数据经纪商，而不是你的汽车制造商。

sentences.en: OK, so they say it's for safety.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以他们说是为了安全。

sentences.en: Does that explanation hold water?
sentences.zh: 这种解释站得住脚吗？

sentences.en: So a version of this has been going on for a long time.
sentences.zh: 这种做法其实已经存在很长时间了。

sentences.en: There's something called usage based insurance where you with your insurance company say,
sentences.zh: 有一种叫做“基于使用量的保险”，你和你的保险公司约定，

sentences.en: OK, I'll put a dongle in my car or I'll put your app on my smartphone and I'll let you monitor my driving.
sentences.zh: “好吧，我会在车里装个适配器，或者在手机上安装你们的应用程序，让你们监控我的驾驶情况。”

sentences.en: And those programs have actually been quite successful.
sentences.zh: 这些项目实际上非常成功。

sentences.en: Like I talked to one expert and he says that when people are knowingly doing this, being observed, that the impact on safety is enormous, that, you know, these people become better
sentences.zh: 我采访过一位专家，他说当人们知情并同意被观察时，对安全的影响是巨大的，这些人确实会成为更好的

sentences.en: drivers.
sentences.zh: 驾驶员。

sentences.en: But that doesn't work if you don't know that you're enrolled in this program.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不知道自己被纳入了这个项目，那就不一样了。

sentences.en: If you don't know that how you drive is going to impact your insurance, then you're not going to improve your driving.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道你的驾驶方式会影响保险，那么你也就不会去改善驾驶习惯。

sentences.en: There's no there's no safety benefit here.
sentences.zh: 这里根本没有任何安全益处。

sentences.en: At the same time, there's this question of what does this data even mean?
sentences.zh: 同时，还有一个问题是，这些数据到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: What is what is hard braking?
sentences.zh: 什么是急刹车？

sentences.en: What is hard acceleration?
sentences.zh: 什么是急加速？

sentences.en: How does it reflect how risky a driver you are?
sentences.zh: 它如何反映你是一个多么危险的驾驶员？

sentences.en: I was actually thinking about this a couple of days ago because I was driving home late at night and a herd of deer just suddenly sprinted across the road and I had to slam on the
sentences.zh: 我前几天还在想这个问题，因为我深夜开车回家时，一群鹿突然冲过马路，我不得不猛踩

sentences.en: brakes and I saved my car insurance company a bunch of money because I didn't hit the deer and damaged my car.
sentences.zh: 刹车，我为我的保险公司省了一大笔钱，因为我没有撞到鹿，也没有损坏我的车。

sentences.en: But I wonder in the data, do I look like a terrible driver who was tailgating somebody and then had to slam on the brakes?
sentences.zh: 但我很怀疑，在数据中，我看起来是不是像个糟糕的司机，紧跟在别人后面，然后不得不猛踩刹车？

sentences.en: I mean, back to your point earlier in the show, right?
sentences.zh: 回到你在节目开头提到的观点，对吧？

sentences.en: These car companies are kind of tech companies in training, right?
sentences.zh: 这些汽车公司本质上是正在成长中的科技公司，对吧？

sentences.en: And and I imagine that they will soon learn some of the lessons that other tech companies have had to learn, which is surveilling your customers, collecting troves of data that
sentences.zh: 我想他们很快就会吸取其他科技公司必须吸取的教训，那就是监视你的客户，收集海量数据，

sentences.en: doesn't go unnoticed for long periods of time.
sentences.zh: 这种行为不可能长期不被发现。

sentences.en: I mean, it will have a response.
sentences.zh: 它必然会引发反弹。

sentences.en: People are not happy about this.
sentences.zh: 人们对此很不高兴。

sentences.en: And I've been watching those.
sentences.zh: 我一直在关注这些动态。

sentences.en: I'm still in those online car forums and I see people reacting to this story and they're saying, oh, my God, I just checked my app and I'm signed up for this.
sentences.zh: 我仍然在那些在线汽车论坛里，我看到人们对这篇报道的反应，他们说：天哪，我刚查了我的应用程序，我竟然注册了这个功能。

sentences.en: I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: They're saying I'm not going to buy a GM car.
sentences.zh: 他们说：我再也不会买通用汽车了。

sentences.en: I'm not going to buy any of the cars that are mentioned in this article.
sentences.zh: 我不会买这篇文章中提到的任何品牌的车。

sentences.en: But the thing is, there's there's lots of different automakers that are doing this.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，有很多不同的汽车制造商都在这样做。

sentences.en: I talked to Senator Ed Markey about this.
sentences.zh: 我为此采访了参议员 Ed Markey。

sentences.en: Senator from Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 来自马萨诸塞州的参议员。

sentences.en: Senator from Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 来自马萨诸塞州的参议员。

sentences.en: He's been talking to car makers, asking them, what data are you collecting about people?
sentences.zh: 他一直在与汽车制造商沟通，询问他们：你们在收集关于人们的什么数据？

sentences.en: Who are you sharing it with?
sentences.zh: 你们在与谁分享这些数据？

sentences.en: And they had sent him some very evasive answers.
sentences.zh: 他们给他的回答非常敷衍。

sentences.en: But he said when I described to him what was happening with GM, he said, that sounds like
sentences.zh: 但他表示，当我向他描述通用汽车发生的事情时，他说：这听起来像是

sentences.en: a violation of the law that protects consumers against unfair and deceptive business practices.
sentences.zh: 违反了保护消费者免受不公平和欺骗性商业行为侵害的法律。

sentences.en: And a couple of days after my story came out, there was a class action lawsuit filed against
sentences.zh: 而且在我的报道发布几天后，就有人对

sentences.en: General Motors and LexisNexis in the Southern District of Florida.
sentences.zh: 通用汽车和 LexisNexis 在佛罗里达州南区提起了集体诉讼。

sentences.en: So this is really a moving target in terms of, you know, in a way, a new social problem.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个不断变化的目标，在某种程度上，这是一个新的社会问题。

sentences.en: I mean, you started digging into the privacy implications of these cars and you found pretty
sentences.zh: 你开始挖掘这些汽车的隐私影响，很快就发现了两个非常严重的例子，说明汽车驾驶员的隐私是如何被侵犯的，这让我不禁想知道，

sentences.en: quickly two very egregious examples of ways car drivers' privacy is being violated, which kind of makes me wonder, you know, what else is going on with these cars that we don't
sentences.zh: 这些汽车上还有什么我们甚至还不知道的事情正在发生？

sentences.en: even know about yet?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这就是我在过去十年左右所看到的情况。

sentences.en: Honestly, this is what I have been seeing in the last decade or so.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这就是我在过去十年左右所看到的情况。

sentences.en: I've been reporting on privacy and data collection.
sentences.zh: 我一直在报道隐私和数据收集方面的新闻。

sentences.en: At first, I was writing about Facebook and Google.
sentences.zh: 起初，我写的是关于Facebook和谷歌的内容。

sentences.en: But now everything is Internet connected.
sentences.zh: 但现在一切都连接到了互联网上。

sentences.en: It's not just cars.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是汽车。

sentences.en: So many of the products we get, your TV, your vacuum, sometimes your bed, your toothbrush, like they want to put a Wi-Fi connection on everything.
sentences.zh: 我们购买的许多产品，比如电视、吸尘器，有时甚至是床和牙刷，他们似乎想给所有东西都装上Wi-Fi连接。

sentences.en: And it can be really convenient.
sentences.zh: 这确实非常方便。

sentences.en: It can give us information remotely.
sentences.zh: 它能让我们远程获取信息。

sentences.en: You know, we can turn things on and off, our lights.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们可以远程开关家里的灯。

sentences.en: But once you have this Internet connection, it means people can get at these devices who previously couldn't.
sentences.zh: 但一旦有了互联网连接，就意味着以前无法接触这些设备的人现在可以接触到了。

sentences.en: And it means that things that don't look like a camera, that don't look like a recording device are.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着那些看起来不像摄像头、不像录音设备的物品，其实就是。

sentences.en: They're watching you and they're gathering information about you.
sentences.zh: 它们在监视你，并在收集关于你的信息。

sentences.en: And it's this big question of who's getting it and how is it going to be used?
sentences.zh: 这就引出了一个大问题：谁在获取这些信息？它们又将被如何使用？

sentences.en: Kashmir, thank you.
sentences.zh: 克什米尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me on, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我来，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In a highly anticipated ruling, a judge overseeing the election interference case against Donald
sentences.zh: 在一项备受期待的裁决中，负责监督针对唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友在佐治亚州选举干预案的法官于周五决定，

sentences.en: Trump and his allies in Georgia decided on Friday that the Fulton County District Attorney,
sentences.zh: 富尔顿县地方检察官法妮·威利斯可以继续负责此案的起诉工作。

sentences.en: Fawnie Willis, could remain in charge of the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 但前提是她之前的浪漫伴侣必须退出该案。

sentences.en: But only if her former romantic partner withdrew from the case.
sentences.zh: 但前提是她之前的浪漫伴侣必须退出该案。

sentences.en: The ruling essentially meant the case against Trump and his allies in Georgia could proceed, since the judge could have removed her and her entire office from the prosecution, but
sentences.zh: 这项裁决实质上意味着针对特朗普及其盟友在佐治亚州的诉讼可以继续进行，因为法官本可以撤销她及其整个办公室的起诉资格，但他

sentences.en: chose not to.
sentences.zh: 选择了不这样做。

sentences.en: The decision revolved around a defendant's claim that Willis should be disqualified because her romance with her office's lead lawyer, Nathan Wade, had given her an inappropriate
sentences.zh: 该决定围绕着一名被告的指控展开，即威利斯应该被取消资格，因为她与办公室首席律师内森·韦德的恋情使她在起诉特朗普时存在不当的

sentences.en: financial stake in prosecuting Trump.
sentences.zh: 经济利益。

sentences.en: Within hours of the ruling, Wade resigned from the case.
sentences.zh: 裁决下达后的几小时内，韦德就辞去了该案的职务。

sentences.en: But even as the judge spared Willis, he refused to fully vindicate her.
sentences.zh: 但即便法官放过了威利斯，他也拒绝完全为她平反。

sentences.en: The ruling described her decision to date Wade and take multiple vacations with him as,
sentences.zh: 裁决将她与韦德约会并多次与他一同度假的决定描述为，

sentences.en: And in Russia, Vladimir Putin garnered 88 percent of the vote in the presidential election held this weekend, according to Russian election authorities.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯，据俄罗斯选举当局称，弗拉基米尔·普京在本周末举行的总统选举中获得了88%的选票。

sentences.en: His win was a foregone conclusion, as the Kremlin had blocked any real competition.
sentences.zh: 他的胜选是预料之中的事，因为克里姆林宫已经封锁了任何真正的竞争。

sentences.en: In a quiet show of opposition, Russians formed long lines at polling stations in several major cities at noon on Sunday, at the request of the team of the now-deceased opposition
sentences.zh: 为了进行无声的抗议，应已故反对派领导人阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼团队的号召，

sentences.en: leader, Alexei Navalny.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯民众于周日中午在多个主要城市的投票站排起了长队。

sentences.en: If Putin serves to 2030, the end of his new term, he will have the longest tenure of any Russian leader since Catherine the Great in the late 1700s.
sentences.zh: 如果普京任职到2030年他新任期的结束，他将成为自18世纪末叶凯瑟琳大帝以来任期最长的俄罗斯领导人。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 你可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
